DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia.

Based on your history of untreated influenza followed by a week of left-sided chest pain, purulent sputum, and shortness of breath, I suspect you have developed a bacterial superinfection. I would like to confirm this with imaging; REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
